standard_prerequisites.name: Cut rule
standard_prerequisites.statement: From derivations of Gamma sequent A and of A, Delta sequent B one derives Gamma, Delta sequent B by cut.
standard_prerequisites.use: The displayed derivation composes pi_0 ( Gamma_0 sequent A ) over pi_1 ( A, Delta_0 sequent B ) by cut.

standard_prerequisites.name: Finite-subset characterization of derivability
standard_prerequisites.statement: Gamma proves A iff some finite Gamma_0 subseteq Gamma has Gamma_0 sequent A derivable.
standard_prerequisites.use: Both hypotheses are unpacked into finite witnesses Gamma_0 and Delta_0 with derivations pi_0 and pi_1.

core_obligations: Statement (prop at line 701): if Gamma proves A and {A} cup Delta proves B, then Gamma cup Delta proves B.

Construction (proof from 707): take finite Gamma_0 subseteq Gamma with derivation pi_0 of Gamma_0 sequent A, and finite Delta_0 subseteq Delta with derivation pi_1 of A, Delta_0 sequent B; display one prooftree cutting pi_0 over pi_1 to obtain Gamma_0, Delta_0 sequent B.
Conclusion: Gamma_0 cup Delta_0 subseteq Gamma cup Delta, so Gamma cup Delta proves B.
proof_roadmap: Unpack both hypotheses into finite witnesses with derivations pi_0 and pi_1.
Compose pi_0 and pi_1 by the cut rule into one derivation of Gamma_0, Delta_0 sequent B.
Conclude by finiteness of the union subset.
